entities.name: Chandler
entities.description: Human con man and rogue of the Homelands on Ulgrotha who stole magical toys and mechanical devices.

entities.name: Wizards' School
entities.description: School on the Floating Island that was Chandler's preferred target.

entities.name: Wizard Savant
entities.description: Head of the Wizards School who placed a bounty on Chandler.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire whose minion was buying stolen devices in preparation for his day of triumph.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: Man whom Chandler and Joven tricked into giving up his Ebony Rhino.

entities.name: Ebony Rhino
entities.description: Eron's prized artifact creature, tricked away by Chandler and Joven.

entities.name: Strongrock
entities.description: Place Eron would punish Chandler or Joven for entering.

events.summary: Chandler stole a ring of keys useful for altering clockwork creatures, earning a bounty from the Wizard Savant.
events.quote: The Wizard Savant of the Wizards School had placed a good-sized bounty on Chandler's head

events.summary: Chandler sold stolen goods to an anonymous buyer, indirectly working for a minion of Baron Sengir.
events.quote: Chandler sold his stolen goods to an anonymous buyer for high prices

events.summary: Chandler and Joven tricked Eron into giving them his Ebony Rhino.
events.quote: Chandler and Joven tricked Eron into giving them his prized Ebony Rhino

relations.quote: Sometimes Chandler worked together with Joven , his partner in crime.

relations.note: Wants revenge for the Ebony Rhino
relations.quote: If Eron ever caught Chandler or Joven on his side of Strongrock
